summary: Frontend-only verification of DynoPay landing (a-d) + fees (e) enhancements. All 4 new landing sections render (ways-to-get-paid, who-pays-fee, coin-showcase, refunds-trust) with correct testids for all 9 way-cards and 3 trust-cards. Interactive whopays toggle works correctly ($100.00/$97.50 <-> $102.50/$100.00). All 6 nav routes return HTTP 200 (creators, fundraisers, documentation, merchants, ecommerce, digital-downloads). Mobile 390x844 has zero horizontal overflow and all sections render. Dark mode applied cleanly (bg rgb(6,6,6), text rgb(250,250,250)) - all new sections readable, toggle continues to work. /fees new sections render with all key strings ('$97.50', '$102.50', '$100', 'On-chain payouts', 'One-click crypto refunds', 'Checkout in 6 languages'). i18n verified: German shows 'Wege zur Bezahlung', 'Neun Wege', 'Wer zahlt die Gebühr? Sie entscheiden.'; French shows 'Neuf façons' and 'Qui paie les frais'. ZERO console errors on any tested view.
